title: 1 Oxytet
content:
PACKAGE LEAFLET: INFORMATION FOR THE USER

TRADE NAME: Oxy-Tet 200 L.A. Long Acting Injection
Registration No: VMD/EA/2022-8819
Marketing Authorisation Holder: Bimeda Animal Health Ltd.

1. COMPOSITION
Each ml contains:
Active substance: Oxytetracycline (as oxytetracycline dihydrate) 200 mg
Excipients: Sodium formaldehyde sulfoxylate, N-methylpyrrolidone, magnesium oxide light.

2. TARGET SPECIES
Cattle (beef and dairy cows, calves), sheep (lambs, ewes), and pigs (swine, sows).

3. INDICATIONS FOR USE
Indicated for the treatment and control of a wide range of common systemic, respiratory, and local infections caused by or associated with organisms sensitive to oxytetracycline.
Specifically:
- Cattle: Pasteurella multocida and Mannheimia haemolytica respiratory infections, bovine keratoconjunctivitis (pinkeye), foul-in-the-foot (foot rot), anaplasmosis.
- Sheep: Enzootic abortion, joint ill, systemic pasteurellosis.
- Pigs: Swine erysipelas, pneumonia, atrophic rhinitis.

4. DOSAGE AND METHOD OF ADMINISTRATION
Deep intramuscular injection.
Recommended dosage: 20 mg/kg bodyweight (equivalent to 1 ml per 10 kg bodyweight).

5. WITHDRAWAL PERIODS
Meat and offal:
- Cattle: 28 days
- Pigs: 21 days
- Sheep: 21 days
Milk:
- Cattle: 10 days (240 hours)
- Sheep: 7 days

6. NATURE AND CONTENTS OF IMMEDIATE PACKAGING
Amber type II glass vials of 100 ml and 250 ml, sealed with bromobutyl rubber stoppers and aluminum tear-off caps.
Box containing 1 x 100 ml or 1 x 250 ml vial.

title: 2 Baytril
content:
SUMMARY OF PRODUCT CHARACTERISTICS

1. NAME OF THE VETERINARY MEDICINAL PRODUCT
Baytril 100 mg/ml Solution for Injection
Registration Number: EU/VMD/049182
Manufacturer: Bayer Animal Health / Elanco Europe Ltd.

2. QUALITATIVE AND QUANTITATIVE COMPOSITION
Active substance:
Enrofloxacin ........................ 100.0 mg per ml
Excipients:
n-Butanol ........................... 30.0 mg
Potassium hydroxide (for pH adjustment)

3. PHARMACEUTICAL FORM
Clear, light yellow solution for injection.

4. TARGET SPECIES
Cattle (calves, adult cattle) and pigs.

5. INDICATIONS FOR USE
Cattle: Treatment of respiratory tract infections caused by Enrofloxacin-susceptible Histophilus somni, Mannheimia haemolytica, Pasteurella multocida and Mycoplasma bovis.
Treatment of acute severe mastitis caused by Escherichia coli.
Pigs: Treatment of bacterial bronchopneumonia caused by Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae, Pasteurella multocida and complicated by Haemophilus parasuis.

6. CONTRAINDICATIONS
Do not use in growing horses because of potential damage to articular cartilage.
Do not use in cases of known resistance to fluoroquinolones.

7. ROUTE OF ADMINISTRATION
Subcutaneous injection in cattle. Intramuscular injection in pigs in the neck behind the ear.
Intravenous injection in severe acute E. coli mastitis.

8. WITHDRAWAL PERIOD
Cattle:
Meat and offal: Subcutaneous: 14 days; Intravenous: 5 days.
Milk: Subcutaneous: 84 hours (3.5 days); Intravenous: 72 hours (3 days).
Pigs:
Meat and offal: Intramuscular: 13 days.

9. PRESENTATIONS
Bottles of 100 ml and 250 ml.
